answer.text:
**How to Take a Credit by Exam (CBE) with Texas Tech K-12**

**1. Get Approval**
- **Full-Time Texas Tech K-12 Students:** Speak with your academic adviser to discuss and approve your Credit By Exam options.
- **Non-Full-Time Students:** Obtain approval from your school counselor to ensure credit will be awarded. Without approval, your school may not grant credit for the exam.

**2. Prepare for the Exam**
- Download the Credit By Exam Review Sheet for your chosen exam from the Texas Tech K-12 catalog. This sheet provides exam content, study tips, and any additional materials needed.
- Some CBEs may require projects or other materials to be submitted at the time of the exam.

**3. Enroll in the Exam**
- Enroll online, through your adviser, or by mail/fax.
- You must select the correct version (Set 1 for your first attempt; Set 2 if you need a second attempt).

**4. Take the Exam**
- You have six months (180 days) from enrollment to take the exam.
- No extensions, refunds, or transfers are allowed.
- Exams are proctored online using Proctorio. You will need:
  - A quiet, distraction-free area
  - A desktop or laptop computer with Google Chrome and the Proctorio extension installed (mobile devices are not supported)
  - A working webcam and microphone
  - A valid photo ID

**5. Receive Credit**
- **Without Prior Instruction:** A score of 80% or higher is required for credit.
- **With Prior Instruction:** A score of 70% or higher is required for credit.
- You may attempt each CBE only twice (Set 1 and Set 2).

**6. Access Your Grade**
- Grades are posted in your portal within two business days after the exam is received.
- You can print a grade report from the portal.

**Quick Checklist**
- Get school approval
- Prepare using the review sheet
- Enroll in the correct CBE version
- Take the exam within 180 days
- Use the required technology and ID
- Check your grade in the portal

**Need Help or Ready to Enroll?**
- Visit the [Texas Tech K-12 Course Catalog](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/k12/) to view available CBEs and enroll.
- For questions, contact Texas Tech K-12 at 1-800-692-6877 or ttuk12@ttu.edu.

**Are Texas Tech K-12 CBEs in Canvas?**

- **Yes, most Texas Tech K-12 Credit by Exams (CBEs) are delivered online through Canvas, the Learning Management System (LMS).**
    - Once you are enrolled in a CBE, you will access the exam through your Canvas account.
    - Proctorio, the online proctoring tool, is used within Canvas for secure exam administration.

**How to Access Your CBE in Canvas:**
- Log in to your Texas Tech K-12 portal.
- Click on the "Canvas" link under the "Applications" tab.
- Your enrolled CBE(s) will appear on your Canvas dashboard.
- Follow the instructions in Canvas to begin your exam.

**Note:**  
- You must use Google Chrome with the Proctorio extension installed for online proctored CBEs.
- If you have any issues accessing your CBE in Canvas, contact Texas Tech K-12 support at 1-800-692-6877 or ttuk12@ttu.edu.
